text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown, has finally 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's just it. Ever since the Asahi Hai 
FS, it seems to have become a habit to 
touch it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I try to focus, this naturally 
happens. What a strange habit I've been 
saddled with. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...How boring.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Only those of the same generation are on 
this stage. I find myself regretting that 
restriction.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime stage... Surely, it 
creates a passion all its own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit of a shame that only folks from 
my own generation can appreciate it, 
though.
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Who's there?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...It's me.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ama-san, huh? What's up? You're not 
running in today's race, are you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
A friendly visit behind enemy lines. Or 
rather, a declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I got my hands on the first tiara. At the 
Oka Sho, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oho, did you come to brag?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No, idiot. Why would I go out of my way to 
do that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...The race you're about to run in is a 
once-in-a-lifetime stage for everyone 
running in it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Don't let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haha, I see. That makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"A once-in-a-lifetime stage truly seems to 
be an irreplaceable experience for a 
racer."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at Ama-san makes it clear. 
Her debut race must have been brutally 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll cast aside all needless worries, such 
as who my opponents might be.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Now then... I wonder what kind of match 
awaits me.
